title: Turning tracking on gives a part with no bin the default bin at zero
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Create an untracked part, part A, for this test with no bin location: its only bin location was deleted in Bin Locations (under Settings) while part A held 0 there, so its window shows no bin row.
  • Start on the Inventory page, on the Active tab, with part A's part number typed in the Search box.
custom_steps:
1. Click the part A row.
  2. Click the Track quantities and cost of goods switch.
  3. Click Save.
  4. Click the part A row again.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Edit Inventory Part opens with the switch off and no bin row in the Inventory section.

Step 2:

  • The switch turns on and the Min and Max fields appear.
  • The Inventory section now holds one bin row: the location's default bin, Quantity 0, marked Default.

Step 3:

  • The window closes with no bin error.
  • Part A's Total Qty cell shows 0 Available (a number, not "Not Tracked"), and Bin Location / Quantity shows the default bin with 0.

Step 4:

  • The saved part keeps that one bin, Quantity 0, marked Default.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10818 (Story 5, Change Tracking on an Existing Part)

  • S5-R7: “In the part dialog, when the user turns tracking on and the part has no bin location, the dialog gives it the location's default bin location, with a quantity of zero, marked as the default.”
